meaning:
σκορπίος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for עַקְרָב ;]
a scorpion: Luk.10:19 11:12, Rev.9:3, 5 9:10 †
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.
Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
